record.body:
## Description

Add ~/se-workflow/tests/test_tmux_integration.py. It starts an isolated tmux server (tmux -L <unique> -f scripts/tmux-dashboard.conf) in a temp repo with a seeded store, runs the prefix + S bound command, and asserts capture-pane shows the dashboard headings for that repo. It reads list-keys for prefix + A, checks it is a display-popup of scripts/dashboard in #{pane_current_path}, and runs that command in a pane to check it renders. It runs scripts/dashboard-status against the store and checks the counts. It skips without tmux. Then run both full suites. Waits for dashboard-launcher and dashboard-status-segment.

payload.title: Integration-test the tmux wiring and verify phase 3

record.subject: verify-tmux-integration-phase
